caption: Figure 4: Paired effects distinguish task completion, immediate reward, and belief discrimination. Each point is the mean profile-minus-pragmatic difference across 128 paired units; whiskers are descriptive 95% percentile intervals from 10,000 case-bootstrap resamples. The three informed profiles use different shapes and colors. Negative differences favor a profile for completion and normalized label entropy; positive differences favor it for five-shot hits. Panel scales vary explicitly by endpoint and stratum. Right-hand F/T/U counts give favorable/tied/unfavorable out of 128; stars and ns refer to the separate 24-test Holm sign-balance procedure, not to interval exclusion of zero. Integer ties are exact and entropy ties use 10⁻¹⁰. Mean intervals retain raw differences and are neither simultaneous nor equivalence bounds. Random is shown on the full completion and trajectory plots and in all numerical tables; it is excluded from this magnified informed-profile view. All profiles use c = 2, zero noise and uniform habits; combined β = 1 and weighted β = 4. Truth is sampled inside each biased generated catalog, not held out.
